name: command

frames.best_why: Frame 2 shows the palette open with both groups, all six commands and the search field.

tagline: A dark command palette with grouped shortcuts and a search field.
summary: A modal command menu with a search box, grouped actions and a shortcut key at the right of each row. Typing filters the list down and the first match is highlighted.
appearance: A dark grey rounded panel on black, topped by a search icon and a placeholder line. Below, two small grey group labels, Suggestions and Settings, separate six white rows, each ending in a tiny outlined shortcut key; the active row is slightly lighter.
behaviour: Typing in the search field filters the rows live; one frame shows a single Billing result under Settings. The first match is selected by default, arrow keys move the highlight, and choosing an item or pressing escape closes the dialog.
demo_content: Suggestions Calendar, Search Emoji, Calculator; Settings Profile, Billing, Appearance, with command-key shortcuts.
use_when: A keyboard-first app wants one searchable menu for navigation, actions and shortcuts.
avoid_when: It is a modal dialog that needs the Dialog component, and on touch it offers no gesture to open itself.
customise: Compose your own items, groups, separators and shortcuts as children, pass a placeholder to CommandInput, and set the dialog title and description. Styling comes through className.
weight_why: A small dialog with a search input and six rows; filtering is local.

a11y.note: The dialog has a hidden title and description and full keyboard control; focus rings are dropped in favour of a row highlight.

issues: Shortcut keys are only labels; no global hotkey actually opens the palette.
Nothing on screen tells users the palette exists besides the demo button.
polish_why: Clean rows and tidy shortcut keys; the advertised hotkeys are cosmetic.
